card.name: Partway through drug names
card.fires_on: Short pieces in the middle of a drug name, such as the 'op' in bosentan-type names or 'vel' in sofosbuvir/velpatasvir. It also fires on the start of a name after a comma in a drug list.

modes.label: Inside a drug name
modes.description: A short piece partway through a drug name that is split into several parts.
modes.example: ir/<<vel>>patasvir is not recommended because it

modes.label: Drug name after a comma
modes.description: The first letter of a drug name that follows a comma in a list of drugs.
